description: Versioned LMFDB cubic class/unit performance corpus with smoke, tuning, and held-out tiers.

snapshot.selection_sql:
COPY (
WITH legacy(label, selection_rank) AS (
  VALUES
    ('3.1.23.1', 1),
    ('3.1.59.1', 2),
    ('3.1.283.1', 3),
    ('3.1.588.1', 4),
    ('3.1.1083.1', 5),
    ('3.1.1371.1', 6),
    ('3.1.1563.1', 7),
    ('3.1.2856.1', 8),
    ('3.1.4027.2', 9),
    ('3.1.5448.1', 10)
), base AS (
  SELECT f.label, f.r2,
         CASE WHEN f.disc_abs <= 10000 THEN 'd0-le-1e4'
              WHEN f.disc_abs <= 100000 THEN 'd1-1e4-1e5'
              WHEN f.disc_abs <= 1000000 THEN 'd2-1e5-1e6'
              ELSE 'd3-1e6-1e7' END AS discriminant_band,
         CASE WHEN f.class_number = 1 THEN 'h0-trivial'
              WHEN jsonb_array_length(f.class_group) > 1 THEN 'h3-noncyclic'
              WHEN f.class_number <= 4 THEN 'h1-cyclic-small'
              ELSE 'h2-cyclic-large' END AS class_band
    FROM nf_fields f
    LEFT JOIN legacy USING (label)
   WHERE f.degree = 3
     AND f.disc_abs <= 10000000
     AND legacy.label IS NULL
     AND f.label <> '3.3.961.1'
), ranked AS (
  SELECT base.*,
         row_number() OVER (
           PARTITION BY r2, discriminant_band, class_band
           ORDER BY md5(label || ':sagejs-cubic-100-v1'), label
         ) AS selection_rank
    FROM base
), selected AS (
  SELECT label, 'smoke'::text AS role, 'legacy-smoke'::text AS stratum,
         selection_rank::bigint
    FROM legacy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT label,
         CASE WHEN selection_rank <= 2 THEN 'tune' ELSE 'holdout' END AS role,
         'r2-' || r2::text || ':' || discriminant_band || ':' || class_band AS stratum,
         selection_rank
    FROM ranked
   WHERE selection_rank <= 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '3.3.961.1', 'holdout', 'canary:totally-real-index-2', 1::bigint
), records AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
           'role', selected.role,
           'stratum', selected.stratum,
           'selection_rank', selected.selection_rank::integer
         ) AS selection,
         f.label, f.degree,
         ARRAY(SELECT coefficient::text FROM unnest(f.coeffs) coefficient)
           AS coefficients,
         f.disc_sign,
         f.disc_abs::text AS discriminant_absolute,
         f.r2,
         (f.degree - f.r2 - 1)::integer AS unit_rank,
         f.disc_rad::text AS discriminant_radical,
         f.index::text AS equation_order_index,
         f.monogenic,
         f.galt AS galois_transitive_group,
         f.galois_label,
         f.num_ram AS ramified_prime_count,
         f.class_number::text AS class_number,
         ARRAY(SELECT invariant FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(f.class_group) invariant)
           AS class_group,
         f.regulator::text AS regulator,
         f.torsion_order,
         f.used_grh,
         f.narrow_class_number::text AS narrow_class_number,
         CASE WHEN f.narrow_class_group IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
           ARRAY(SELECT invariant::text FROM unnest(f.narrow_class_group) invariant)
         END AS narrow_class_group,
         f.unit_signature_rank
    FROM selected
    JOIN nf_fields f USING (label)
   ORDER BY f.degree, f.disc_abs, f.label
)
SELECT row_to_json(records) FROM records
) TO STDOUT;

tiers.policy: Tune only on smoke+tune. Observe holdout after an optimization decision is frozen.
